licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each transcribed independently, disagreements settled on the page by a separate judge, then checked against the print and corrected. The print's fifteen chorus staves are gathered here into five by voice (every note and syllable kept, each group named where it comes in). Tempo from the printed metronome mark; where none is printed, a value chosen as stated in the piece's notes.
